# truenas_network_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS global network configuration (hostname, domain, DNS servers, default gateways, service announcement). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one global network configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Primary DNS domain name.
- `domains` (List of String) Additional DNS search domains.
- `hostname` (String) System hostname.
- `hosts` (List of String) Additional /etc/hosts entries.
- `httpproxy` (String) HTTP proxy URL used by the system for outbound HTTP(S) requests.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "network_config".
- `ipv4gateway` (String) Default IPv4 gateway.
- `ipv6gateway` (String) Default IPv6 gateway.
- `nameserver1` (String) Primary DNS nameserver.
- `nameserver2` (String) Secondary DNS nameserver.
- `nameserver3` (String) Tertiary DNS nameserver.
- `service_announcement` (Attributes) Network service announcement/discovery protocols enabled on the system. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_announcement))

<a id="nestedatt--service_announcement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_announcement`

Read-Only:

- `mdns` (Boolean) Whether mDNS (multicast DNS) service announcement is enabled.
- `netbios` (Boolean) Whether NetBIOS name service announcement is enabled.
- `wsd` (Boolean) Whether WS-Discovery service announcement is enabled.
